source.label: Eternal Central, "Gen Con 2011 Vintage Champs Top 8 Decks" (7 August 2011)

notes.text: No Wizards coverage of the 2011 Vintage Championship was found. Eternal Central places the Top 8 1 to 8; 3rd and 4th are given here as 3-4 and 5th to 8th as 5-8. Seeds are not known.
Mark Hornung beat Nick Coss, Ryan Glackin and Paul Mastriano (Hornung's report), so Mastriano was the finalist. CoolStuffInc wrongly lists Menendian as the finalist.

Date: mtgtop8 dates the event 05/08/11 (Friday). Hornung's report has the Block Championship the night before and him wanting to "sleep Friday", which fits Friday 5 August; no source states the day directly.
Player count (140) is from mtgtop8; Eternal Central gives none. mtgtop8's list for Menendian is a copy of Mastriano's.
